objectives.note: verify-deploy.sh (no flags) ran to completion: 37 of 43 checks PASS. 6 FAIL, all accounted for: gate3 (doc-lint) + gate5 (manifest content-hash) + gate13 (whole-tree orphan detection) are expected pre-redeploy drift from this task's own source-store edits not yet deployed (Phase 7 resolves via deploy-headless.sh; Phase 5's own plan text anticipates exactly this for orphan detection). gate24 (/ide dead-command lint) is pre-existing and unrelated -- confirmed via git diff --stat on the two flagged files (memory-setup.md, memory-troubleshooting.md), both untouched by this task. gate8 (run-all.sh) and gate10 (validate-state.sh --deep) failed during a window of heavy concurrent load; both were independently re-verified: gate10 passes cleanly (20/0) via the deployed path outside the contended window; gate8's full battery could not be independently re-run because specs/.gate-lock is held by a dead process (pid 2227797, confirmed via 'ps -p' returning nothing) with >=5 sibling run-all.sh invocations queued behind it -- a repo-wide, multi-session contention issue recorded via issue-record.sh (class: gate collision, severity: costly), not worked around by clearing the lock myself. As a substitute, the three test suites this phase's own edits touch (test-orchestrate-build-aux-dispatch.sh, test-manifest-scripts-sync.sh, test-script-inventory.sh) were each run standalone and pass cleanly (22/0, 19/0, 32/0).
